improvements.rationale: These tags improve search engine click-through rates by clearly communicating the product value and free trial offer. Open Graph and Twitter Card tags ensure professional, branded previews when shared on social platforms, increasing trust and engagement. Including the price anchor and free searches creates urgency and transparency.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace built for professionals. Try three free searches — no card required."
improvements.rationale: This headline clearly introduces Gideon by name while immediately communicating its core function (AI trade and business assistant). The subheading reinforces three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) and removes friction by highlighting the free trial with no payment commitment upfront. The copy is direct, builds trust, and creates a low-barrier entry point for conversions.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to become a member to continue accessing Gideon. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, and annual plans save you 30 percent. As a member, you'll unlock unlimited access to your personal workspace, voice chat, and professional trade and business support—no interruptions, no limits.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in the conversion funnel—what happens at the paywall. By clearly explaining the transition from free trial to paid membership and reinforcing the value (unlimited access, voice chat, workspace), it reduces uncertainty and positions the paywall as an upgrade rather than a barrier.
